description: This file defines the 'Field' struct within the Orleans.Serialization.WireProtocol namespace, representing a field header with properties and methods for serialization, including handling of tags, field IDs, types, and wire types.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a field header with properties and methods for serialization, including handling of tags, field IDs, types, and wire types.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Field with a Tag.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Field with a Tag, extended field ID delta, and type.

methods.name: get_FieldIdDelta
methods.description: Gets the field ID delta, either from raw or extended value.

methods.name: set_FieldIdDelta
methods.description: Sets the field ID delta, embedding it into the Tag if possible, or invalidating it.

methods.name: get_FieldType
methods.description: Gets the field type, with validation in debug mode.

methods.name: set_FieldType
methods.description: Sets the field type, with validation in debug mode.

methods.name: get_HasFieldId
methods.description: Indicates if the field has a valid embedded field ID.

methods.name: get_HasExtendedFieldId
methods.description: Indicates if the field has an extended field ID.

methods.name: get_WireType
methods.description: Gets the wire type from the Tag.

methods.name: set_WireType
methods.description: Sets the wire type in the Tag.

methods.name: get_SchemaType
methods.description: Gets the schema type, with validation in debug mode.

methods.name: set_SchemaType
methods.description: Sets the schema type in the Tag.

methods.name: get_ExtendedWireType
methods.description: Gets the extended wire type, with validation in debug mode.

methods.name: set_ExtendedWireType
methods.description: Sets the extended wire type in the Tag.

methods.name: get_IsSchemaTypeValid
methods.description: Checks if the schema type is valid.

methods.name: get_HasExtendedSchemaType
methods.description: Checks if the schema type is extended.

methods.name: get_IsEndBaseFields
methods.description: Checks if the field indicates end of base fields.

methods.name: get_IsEndObject
methods.description: Checks if the field indicates end of object.

methods.name: get_IsEndBaseOrEndObject
methods.description: Checks if the field indicates end of base or object.

methods.name: get_IsReference
methods.description: Checks if the wire type is Reference.

methods.name: EnsureWireTypeTagDelimited
methods.description: Ensures the wire type is TagDelimited, throws if not.

methods.name: EnsureWireType
methods.description: Ensures the wire type matches the expected type, throws if not.
